messages.subject: waterfall plot function wt() patch
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I’ve encountered a
problem while using the wt() (waterfall plot) function of seewave
while trying to plot all waveforms in my data set in different
colours specified by me. It’s a feature which is required by a
program I’m working on and currently doing this (passing a vector
of colours to col in wt()) causes the plotting time to increase
dramatically and changes the style of the plot.

I introduced a
little change to the code and it fixed the problem. The plotting time
dropped from 21.6 s to 0.243 s. for a single call of wt() function,
which is necessary, as  by me it is used interactively in a shiny
application. It would be great if this patch was introduced in the
next release.

Here is the patch (typed out as I can't attach the patch file):

diff --git a/R/seewave.r b/R/seewave.r
index e4bed4f..92270e9 100755
--- a/R/seewave.r
+++ b/R/seewave.r
@@ -7912,7 +7912,9 @@ wf <- function(
     }

                                         # colors
-  if(!is.function(col)) {col <- rep(col,dim(data)[2])} else {col <- col(dim(data)[2])}
+  if(!is.function(col)) {
+    if (dim(data)[2]!=length(col)) col <- rep(col,dim(data)[2])
+  } else {col <- col(dim(data)[2])}

                                         # seek for axes ticks: look for the column including the maximum value
                                         # and get the values for both axes with a 'virtual' plot
